events.body:
## Summary

Make BLT-Jobs transparent and trustworthy by showing how jobs/profiles move from Git submission to published data.

## Scope

- Maintainer review lifecycle.
- GitLab label/state mapping.
- Source traceability on public pages.
- Board health/status page.
- Static data loading reliability.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define lifecycle states: submitted, needs-info, approved, published, rejected, flagged, expired, archived.
- [ ] Map states to GitLab labels and/or Markdown fields.
- [ ] Display source issue/MR/commit links where available on job and seeker detail pages.
- [ ] Add last generated/updated timestamps to relevant public pages.
- [ ] Add a board health page showing counts, stale/expired listings, profiles, and validation status.
- [ ] Fix homepage live sections so they use real generated data or polished fallbacks.
- [ ] Avoid raw `Unable to load...` states on public pages.

## Parent

Tracked by #12: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/2
